title: Rawdata of mouse gut microbiota and NK92 cells RNAseq in Butyric Acid regulating CX3CR1+NK study
description: 16s rRNA gene sequencing was used to study the gut microbiota changes in antibiotic-treated mice before and after fecal microbiota transplantation. RNAseq was used to determine significantly changed genes in NK92 cells pretreated with butyric acid.

runs.experiment_title: HiSeq X Ten sequencing: RNAseq of NK92 cells
